year_conference_matrix.formal_type_basis: Edition-specific D&B CFP follows Main CFP, specifies full-paper submission and camera-ready, and says accepted papers published in NeurIPS proceedings. Each497 index entry has data-track=datasets_and_benchmarks_track and individual formal publication page. Not inferred from PDF length.
year_conference_matrix.denominator_scope: Formally published Datasets and Benchmarks Track full papers only; separate from Main and Position; excludes workshops and competitions
notes: Six complete abstracts and six focused principal-body reads; no whole-appendix claim. The 497-entry metadata inventory is not abstract screening completion. Six scientific IN: three public profiles and three material HOLDs. Unique lower-bound credit uses 345 historical identity-field blobs and a bounded 1142-file prior-reading audit with no alias/completion hit; not proof of never-before reading. Prior aggregate totals are inherited registration, not a new historical certification; prior ACL per-ID manifest gap remains unresolved. DrVD promotion adds no scientific reading credit; original six reading events remain unchanged.

publisher_acm.method: Resolve each annual main research proceedings volume via DBLP DOI links; enumerate publisher table of contents; exclude companion, demo, short, workshop, front matter. Research papers in journal-integrated proceedings need event mappings.

publisher_ieee.method: Resolve each annual research-proceedings volume from DBLP; enumerate full regular research papers only. Separate companion/workshop/poster volumes.

publisher_springer.method: Resolve all annual LNCS/LNAI main-proceedings parts from DBLP; enumerate research chapters, excluding prefaces, keynotes without full papers, indexes and ancillary tracks.

dblp.method: Use DBLP as a discovery and reconciliation layer, not an unfiltered denominator. Conference indexes can include workshops and journal-integrated tracks. Paginate searches; API hit caps and title-only searches cannot establish exhaustiveness.

excluded_examples.note: This is a CCF-A conference scope, not a ranking of medical-conference relevance.

paper_scope.include: Full or regular research papers in eligible conference tracks; explicitly tag any additional full-paper special tracks. Main-track-only view should be the default for comparable ratios.
paper_scope.deduplication: DOI first, then normalized title + author + event; one paper may have multiple source links but one record.
paper_scope.year_rule: Conference edition year; explicitly map journal-first/event-integrated papers instead of using calendar publication year.

include: Protein, gene, cell and other biomedical science without a required clinical endpoint
Medical or biomedical-centered formal long surveys
exclude_or_review: General or natural-image-led work with incidental biomedical experiments
medical_definition.screening_rule: Include medical or biomedical-only studies and studies whose primary objective and experiments are medical or biomedical, including generic methods. Protein, gene, cell, and other biomedical research does not require a clinical endpoint. Ancillary natural-image experiments do not disqualify biomedical-led work. Exclude primarily natural-image or general-task studies with incidental biomedical evaluation; ecology, agriculture, and biomimetic engineering are not automatically biomedical. Actual research and experiment balance determines eligibility; medical/biomedical-centered long surveys are eligible based on their reviewed corpus. Unresolved candidates stay outside counted records.

statistics.within_conference_share: 100 × included medical full papers / all eligible full papers in the same conference-year and track scope. Show unavailable, not 0, until both inventories are complete.
statistics.medical_distribution_share: Indexed medical/biomedical papers by conference in the complete current catalogue; Insights ignore card filters.
statistics.completeness: See the per-edition and per-track coverage ledger for verified counts, unresolved cases and census completion.

source_notes.finding: Official index explicitly notes datasets-and-benchmarks papers join main proceedings from 2022; classify tracks explicitly.

Actual research and experiment balance determines eligibility; medical/biomedical-centered long surveys are eligible based on their reviewed corpus. latest_catalogue.verification: CCF-authored full PDF audited across all ten A-conference tables; independently roster-compared against the 2022 manifest. Library labels it seventh-edition final version. Official CCF release text verified from indexed source; direct official HTML retrieval returned CAPTCHA/405, so official attachment URL is not claimed.

requested_end: Latest formally published edition; 2027 and later are added only after publication is verified.

stage_coverage.definition: Distinct existing progress track rows by recorded stage. Conference/edition counts are the coverage of these tracks, not claims that every track in those conferences or editions is complete.
